title: Personal CRM & Networking Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=followup:reminder
| eval day_type=if(in(strftime(_time,"%u"),"6","7"),"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(duration_min) as avg_duration by day_type
description: Separates personal crm activity between weekdays and weekends when duration is present.
value: Weekend/weekday splits quickly show whether a life domain is work-driven, leisure-driven, or bleeding into the wrong days.
implementation: Populate optional `duration_min` on `followup:reminder` events if available; the search still works on counts alone when duration is missing.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart of weekday vs weekend event counts.
grandmaExplanation: It works out whether your personal crm activity mostly happens on weekdays or weekends so you can see if the habit fits the life you actually live.
